chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umeyr, from Jamil ibn Darraj, from Zurara, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said:
Ali (peace be upon him) inherited the Knowledge of the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family), and Fatima (peace be upon her) inherited his legacy.
ai.seo_question: What did Ali and Fatima inherit from the Prophet Muhammad?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi articulates the Shia doctrine of complementary spiritual and material inheritance, where Imam Ali (AS) receives the esoteric and exoteric knowledge (Ilm) of the Prophet, while Fatima (AS) inherits his worldly legacy (Tarakah). Scholars interpret this as establishing the Ahl al-Bayt as the dual custodians of the prophetic mission, ensuring both the preservation of divine wisdom and the continuity of the Prophet's physical lineage and authority.

en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Jameel Bin Darraj, from Zurara, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup>
having said: ‘Ali<sup>asws</sup> inherited the Knowledge of Rasool-Allah<sup>saw</sup>, and Fatima<sup>asws</sup> inherited his<sup>saw</sup> legacy’.
en.sarwar: 1. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ibn abu ‘ Umayr from Jamil ibn Darraj from Zurarah who has narrated the following: “Abu Ja’far, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said,

‘Ali, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, inherited the knowledge of the Messenger of Allah, O Allah, grant compensation to Muhammad and his family worthy of their services to Your cause, and Fatimah, Alayha al-Salam, inherited his legacy.’”
